checks: paired syntax and compiled controls; external receipts
cost: O(L) lexical work plus bit-length-dependent GCD/power/root arithmetic. Decimal output O(places) allocation; no memory quota or allocation error interface.
description: Arbitrary rational parsing, exact roots and decimal presentation
forward: frac rejects zero denominator and normalizes sign. parse_q strips spaces/underscores, splits slash recursively before comma/exponent processing, then multiplies by10^(exp-fraction_digits). exact_decimal factors denominator by2 and5; roots verify r^k=n.
inverse: Reduced n/d has every representable signed pair(kn,kd), k nonzero, as antecedents and many accepted lexical spellings. Fixed root degree maps r back to r^k. show_nice/f64 are many-to-one; exact show retains rational value.
limitations: Partial lexical projection; no semantic proof
